basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1359. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1359 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: On dark brown silk, a single long plum branch sweeps down from the top of the scroll in a great curve, its twigs covered in small blossoms painted in ink alone. Inscriptions run along the left side and across a colophon above.
alt.zh: 在深褐色的绢上，一根长长的梅枝从画幅顶端以一道大弧线垂下，细枝上开满只用墨画成的小花。左侧和上方的题跋上都写着字。

note.en: Wang Mian, a Yuan scholar who declined office and lived by his brush, is remembered above all for ink plum: blossom painted without colour, in ink alone. The English title, Fragrant Snow at Broken Bridge, comes from a later label strip and from his own poem on the scroll, in which a warm wind scatters the blossoms like snow. One branch is enough to fill the whole scroll.
note.zh: 王冕是不肯做官、靠笔墨为生的元代文人，最为人记住的是墨梅：不设色，只用墨画梅。英文题名“断桥香雪”来自后人的题签，也来自画上他自己的诗，诗里“暖风吹乱雪飘飘”，把落梅写成了雪。一枝梅，就足以填满整幅画。
